title: 'permission denied for schema public' when an app role runs migrations on PostgreSQL 15 or later
symptoms: ERROR: permission denied for schema public
CREATE TABLE works as the database owner or a superuser but not as the app role
The same migration succeeds against a PostgreSQL 14 server
cause: PostgreSQL 15 removed the default CREATE privilege for PUBLIC on the public schema in new clusters and new databases, and made pg_database_owner its owner. Upgraded clusters and restored dumps keep the old grants, so environments disagree.
fix: Make the app role own the database, or grant CREATE on the schema to it explicitly.
affected: PostgreSQL 15 and later (October 2022), new clusters and newly created databases
